chatslash.hotkeys:
| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter | Send; while omp works, steer the running turn (read at its next step) |
| Ctrl+Enter | While omp works: queue a follow-up (sent after the turn) |
| Shift+Enter | New line |
| Esc | Close a menu or panel; while omp works, stop and keep the draft |
| ↑ / ↓ | Previous / next sent message (in a one-line box) |
| / | Command menu |
| @ | Project file menu |
| !command | Run a shell command in omp; the output joins the context |
| Tab | Pick from an open menu |

settingsaccount.noteLogin: Clicking Log in opens a browser and prompts for an authorization code. Complete login in the browser, or cancel from the prompt or this button (restarts omp in the same session). Only one login can proceed at a time.

settingsdialog.headingAgentAdvanced: RAD Agent (this PC, applies after omp restart)
settingsdialog.noActiveProjectRole: No active project. Open a project to configure project-specific omp settings.
settingsdialog.noteCompatibility: Automatically checked on startup after updating omp. Verifies command-line options, RPC protocol, IDE tool registration, and response fields without calling models.
settingsdialog.noteInstallClangd: Downloads the latest clangd for Windows (LLVM, Apache-2.0, about 30 MB) into %LOCALAPPDATA%\RADAgent\clangd and fills in the path. Press again to update.
settingsdialog.noteProgress: Disabled items are hidden from chat. Re-enabling them reveals past content. Errors and approval requests are always shown.
settingsdialog.noticeRestartPending: omp settings saved. omp will restart after the current task finishes.
settingsdialog.noticeSaved: omp settings saved. Changes will take effect after restarting omp.
settingsdialog.ompPathHint: Leave empty to find on PATH: %s
settingsdialog.title: RAD Agent Settings
settingsdialog.turnNotify: Windows notification when omp finishes while the IDE is in the background
settingsproject.headingDefaults: omp Defaults (this project, applies after omp restart)
settingsproject.noteApproval: omp tool approval is the same setting as the approval mode below the chat input. Both omp built-in tools (bash, write, etc.) and rad.* tools modifying IDE buffers and forms follow this setting.
settingsproject.noteFormEditing: UI building: with "form designer required" omp builds forms, dialogs, menus and panels with the designer tools and creates controls in code only when data decides them. Form file text editing: when not allowed, omp gets no rad.form_text_edit. Both are saved in .omp\radagent-ide.json of this project; omp restarts.
settingsproject.noteMcp: Turn MCP servers on or off from + at the bottom-left of the input box -> MCP servers. Modified via omp's /mcp command; servers defined in the project file are saved there, others in user settings.
settingsproject.noteRoles: Models used for each role. If left empty, global settings are used. You can append a thinking level such as :high after a model. Changes apply only to this project and take effect after restarting omp.
settingsproject.noteSession: Auto-compact shortens the conversation when the context fills up; auto-retry repeats a failed request (a waiting retry can be stopped in the chat). A message typed while omp works either steers the running turn (Enter) or waits as a follow-up for the turn to end (Ctrl+Enter). Steering and follow-up mode send queued messages one at a time or all at once; interrupt mode reads steering between tool calls or only after the turn.
settingsproject.noteToggles: Unchecking prevents omp from loading it in this project. Skills excluded in global settings cannot be enabled here. Changes take effect after restarting omp.
settingsproject.uiBuildingDesigner: Form designer required (code only for data-driven parts)
settingsproject.uiBuildingFree: Free (UI may also be built in code)
